comments.text: Cory just a bit of RE lore, so basically Luis made Nemesis from RE3. He played a really big part in the creation of the NE-alpha parasite which is the main thing that gives Nemesis his power along with the T-virus. The reason Luis knows so much about the plagas parasite (the one infecting everyone in RE4) is because he studied it for Umbrella. The NE-a parasite is a modified version of las plagas which Luis made. Nemesis started off as a tyrant just like Mr. X from RE2 and they injected a tyrant with the NE-a parasite to create the monstrosity we know as the Nemesis. A key bit of info is the Europe Umbrella Team photo in Luis's office and if you look close you can see Luis in the photo. At the beginning of RE3 remake the same Europe team was shown making Nemesis. Cool little detail from Capcom that interconnects all the RE games together.
